whatsappMessage:
Hi Vijay Kumar,

I noticed Tasty Food Point has a strong 4.4★ rating on Fraser Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and menu page for local food lovers.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special menu highlights, aur Google Maps location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/tastyfood

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Vijay Kumar ji, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Tasty Food Point) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and a digital menu showcase for Fraser Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
